explanation: Amendment 1 set Tansley Parcel's volume discount at 14% effective 2025-07-01, and the renewal order form (effective 2026-02-01) carries that 14% forward for the renewal term, so it applies on 2026-03-01. The earlier 10% discount from the original subscription agreement was superseded.
